message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Fu purchased a three-wheeled cargo motorcycle from Zhuang (who stole it). Fu bought it for 6000 RMB, used it for his own business. The stolen vehicle was originally stolen from victim Deng. Fu knowingly bought a stolen vehicle? The facts: "傅某为了方便拉货，委托庄某再物色便宜盗赃三轮摩托车。" Means Fu asked Zhuang to find cheap stolen three-wheeler. So Fu knowingly intended to acquire stolen property. He purchased it. That is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" (concealing/receiving stolen property). Also possibly "盗窃" because he took the vehicle? But he didn't steal; he bought. The correct label per earlier examples: For case where buyer knows it's stolen, they used "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". Example: earlier: "高某在明知蓝色飞鹰牌二轮摩托车是盗窃所得的情况下，从于某某处以1500元的价格购买。" The answer: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". So same scenario. So answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "职务侵占"? No. "盗窃"? No. So single label.
